seo.title: Invest in AITS | All India Truckshed
seo.description: AITS is building professional, technology-enabled truck washing infrastructure for India's commercial fleets, sold on recurring B2B fleet contracts.

hero.title: Building the infrastructure layer for India's commercial trucking
hero.lead: AITS starts with AITS Wash: professional, technology-enabled truck washing, sold to fleets on recurring monthly contracts.
hero.imageAlt: Concept illustration of a planned AITS Wash facility

thesis.title: A clear gap, a repeatable model and a long runway.

items.title: An informal market
items.text: Truck washing is still largely informal, manual and untracked. Fleets have no wash history, no fleet-level visibility and no centralized billing.

items.title: A professional product
items.text: A defined, repeatable wash process built for the diversity of Indian commercial trucks, with every wash recorded digitally.

items.title: Recurring B2B revenue
items.text: Fleets sign monthly contracts with a minimum wash commitment and a fixed price per wash, billed on one consolidated invoice.

items.title: A platform for more
items.text: Each AITS site is designed as a base for future truck services, built step by step.

model.title: Revenue grows with every truck and every wash.
model.lead: AITS becomes more powerful as fleet utilization increases.

items.title: Fleet contracts
items.text: Minimum monthly wash commitment of 30 trucks · Fixed price per truck per wash

items.title: Consolidated billing
items.text: One invoice per fleet per month · No per-driver payment friction

items.title: Digital records
items.text: Every wash captures vehicle ID, date, time, location, wash type and amount

items.title: Water recycling
items.text: Treatment and reuse built into the infrastructure to reduce freshwater demand

figures.note: Figures are illustrative and subject to validation.
